title: Ten of Me. Zero Guesswork.
subtitle: The Tender Intelligence Squad: ten AI agents, one pipeline, one human decision.

narrator.intro: Meet the Tender Intelligence Squad: ten agents, one pipeline, and a face you may recognise.
narrator.finale: Nine agents prepare the evidence. Agent ten builds the portfolio. And one human makes the final call: Doctor Walid Barakat.

human.name: Dr.-Ing. Walid Barakat
human.role: Bid authority · the human in the loop
human.fn: Approves or rejects the portfolio with a written rationale. Nothing is submitted automatically.

agents.name: Source validator
agents.fn: Searches the EU Funding & Tenders API for Energy calls, normalises each record and rejects malformed ones.
agents.line: Agent one, source validator, first in line. I pull every Energy call from the EU portal and reject broken records.

agents.name: Relevance triage
agents.fn: Scores relevance on metadata only and decides: archive, watch or advance.
io: A shortlist: 14 of 25 on the live run
agents.line: Agent two, relevance triage. I read the metadata only: archive, watch or advance. Last run, I advanced fourteen of twenty-five.

agents.name: ReAct researcher
agents.fn: Reasons, acts and observes: chooses the next MCP tool until the evidence is enough.
agents.line: Agent three, the ReAct researcher. I choose the next tool, read the answer, and stop when the evidence is enough.

agents.name: Document intelligence
agents.fn: Extracts, cleans and chunks the tender documents.
agents.line: Agent four, document intelligence. I open the annexes, clean them, and cut them into searchable chunks.

agents.name: RAG grounding
agents.fn: Stores chunks in Pinecone and retrieves cited passages, with a labelled local fallback.
agents.line: Agent five, RAG grounding. I keep those chunks in Pinecone and return evidence with its citations.

agents.name: Eligibility
agents.fn: Checks the mandatory conditions against the company profile. Any failure means no bid.
agents.line: Agent six, the eligibility gate. I check the mandatory conditions. If one fails, the answer is no bid.

agents.name: Technical, finance, risk
agents.fn: Score delivery feasibility, margin and bid cost, and risk exposure.
agents.line: Agent seven. We are three specialists: can we deliver it, does it pay, and what could go wrong?

agents.name: Decision strategy
agents.fn: Weighs the scores into BID, CONDITIONAL BID or NO BID, with the conditions written out.
agents.line: Agent eight, decision strategy. I weigh the scores into bid, conditional bid or no bid, with the conditions written out.

agents.name: Report and run director
agents.fn: Publishes the report to Drive, updates the Notion radar, alerts Slack and records the receipts.
agents.line: Agent nine, report and run director. I publish every report to Drive, Notion and Slack, and I keep the receipts.

agents.name: Portfolio strategist
agents.fn: Checks a bid is still possible, simulates 4,000 outcomes per bid, chooses the portfolio, then waits for a human.
agents.line: Agent ten, the new one from Checkpoint two. I simulate four thousand futures per bid, choose the portfolio, and wait for a human.
